Choose G from 0–5 available gallons in Water Reserve and spend them with Chakra. As a Main Action, remove one external physical Immobilization and flow to a legal point within max(2, 2G) yards. As a Defensive Interrupt against one non-AoE, non-Genjutsu Attack, use the Parry below. Doton and Raiton cannot be Parried with this technique.

Choose a continuous route through openings at least 1 inch wide. The listed movement distance is already adjusted for Hydration; sealed barriers stop it. Gallons spent are consumed. Removed restraints are left behind, while internal conditions, sealing effects and shadow possession remain.

Make a Ninjutsu Parry with +1 per full 2 gallons spent. On full success, negate the Attack, remove one eligible restraint and move. On Partial Success, resolve the reduced Attack at your starting point, then remove the restraint and move if you remain able to act. On a full failure, remain in place. Hydration’s passive mitigation applies to damage you take. Ending Hydration during the hit cancels the escape and movement.
Hijutsu: Sensatsu Suishou - Secret Technique: Thousand Flying Water Needles
This technique's damage is considered 25% higher for the purpose of inflicting wounds, and it always inflicts Piercing wounds. If it wounds an enemy, it also applies one wound of the next-lower rank.
Hijutsu: Makyo Hyosho - Secret Technique: Demonic Mirror Ice Crystals
Heritage: Yuki; X*2 Gallons of Water and/or Ice in any combination

You create X Demonic Ice Mirrors. These remain stationary on the battlefield, even floating mid air. They are one yard wide, two yards tall, and a few inches thick. They may be attacked, but you must deal CHA*2 Damage in a single attack to destroy one (otherwise they just regenerate). While within 1 yard of a Mirror you can step into it and out any other mirror at will. Practically speaking, this means that you can go from one mirror to any other mirror using only 1 yard of movement, and you can draw range and line of sight from any of the other mirrors. This includes taking the Observe action (which is done from every Mirror) and things like Dodge, where you can calculate your movement versus an AoE as beginning at any Mirror.
If X is 20 or higher, this Jutsu forms a cage around an area. Stop tracking individual Ice Mirrors. Instead note a space on the battlefield as being the Cage, which has a Radius of up to your CHA/4 Yards. While within this area, the user steps into the Mirrors and begins bouncing between the Mirrors too quickly for the eye to see. This grants the following benefits:
The user enters Level 1 Stealth, and may perform the Hide Action without any further justification.
You can perform any form of attack while in Stealth without breaking that Stealth. The attack lowers the Stealth TN as though it were a Ranged Weapon attack.
Until an enemy defeats the user's Stealth, that enemy suffers -4 Accuracy on attacks against the user and cannot make Called Shots against them. An Area attack that covers the entire cage ignores this penalty.
Once per 10 IC, when a creature attempts to leave the cage, you can convert their next non-Interrupt Action into a single-target Attack with a final Speed of 10 or less and resolve it as an Interrupt against that creature. Pay all normal costs. After it resolves, set the user's next IC no earlier than the current IC plus that Attack's final Speed. On a full hit that deals damage, the creature's movement ends at the edge of the cage. This is the user's next Action, not a free additional attack.
You can consider themselves to be anywhere within the cage when they take an action.
An enemy who has found you (usually by beating your Stealth TN) is tracking your movements. They may attack you normally, treating you as being anywhere inside of the Cage when they attack. If you Hide again, this penalty is lost until the opponent again finds you.
Mirrors that form the cage reform instantly if they are destroyed.
This user cannot benefit from this Jutsu, either the individual mirrors or the cage, if they are Grabbed or incapable of movement. Using this Jutsu again removes all previously established Demonic Ice Mirrors, releasing their Upkeep appropriately.

Raise an ice shell around yourself or a point within 10 yards. It has HP equal to CHA x 5 and DR 15. It can intercept one incoming Attack when created. When destroyed, it leaves 6 gallons of usable Ice on the battlefield.
Hyouton: Jisarenhyo - Ice Release: Earthen Consecutive Chains of Ice

On hit apply Immobilization 5, fading by 1 after each 10 IC without a refresh. Hyōton: Sensatsu Kōri - Thousand Ice Needles

Create or invest 0–10 gallons of Ice. Deal 8d10 + Gd10 as one Ninjutsu Area Attack. Apply Immobilization 2, increased to 4 if at least 1 gallon is used. Suiton: Sameodori Kekkai - Shark-Dance Water Prison

While maintained, heated mist surrounds you. For Attacks and Awareness checks made against you, other creatures suffer an additional -2 Visibility Penalty. This penalty stacks with other Visibility penalties, to the normal maximum. You ignore the Visibility Penalty created by this Jutsu.
After a Melee Attack made against you resolves, the attacker takes CHA/2 Energy Damage that ignores DR. After one of your Melee Attacks against another creature resolves, that creature takes the same Damage whether or not the Attack hit. A creature can take this scald Damage at most once per Action. This is a separate automatic damage effect: it makes no Accuracy roll, does not allow a separate Defensive Interrupt, and is not reduced by the triggering Attack's Partial Success or Block. Check Wounds and Armor against it separately.

Use Steam Reversal as a Defensive Interrupt against a Melee Attack. Spend 1 to 3 Steam, then move up to 3 yards per Steam spent in any direction before making your Defensive Roll.

Futton: Fushoku Kiri - Corrosive Mist Prison

Fill the Area with acidic vapour. When this Jutsu resolves, other creatures in the Area defend against it normally as an AoE Attack. A creature that is not fully defended takes 5d10 Energy Damage, reduced by Partial Success as normal. A successful Defense prevents only this initial Damage; the mist remains in the Area.
While the Upkeep is maintained, another creature that enters the Area or begins an Action inside it takes 5d10 Energy Damage, to a maximum of once per Action. This recurring Environmental Damage makes no Accuracy roll and does not allow a separate Defensive Interrupt.
Whenever Armor absorbs Damage from this Jutsu, double the Durability lost from that Absorption. Damage this Jutsu deals directly to Armor or created barriers is also doubled. Each time Armor absorbs Damage from the mist, reduce that Armor piece's Absorption by 5%, to a maximum reduction of 25% from this Jutsu. This reduction remains while its wearer is inside the mist and until the end of their next Action after leaving it.

When declaring this Jutsu, choose X up to CHA/3, limited by the total gallons of battlefield water available to be destroyed. When it resolves, boil off X gallons. Remove uninvested battlefield water first, then water invested in maintained Jutsu if necessary.
Dissolving World is centered on you and has an Area of X/2 yards, minimum 10 and maximum 50.
Other creatures in the Area defend against this Jutsu normally. A creature that is not fully defended takes X × Ninjutsu Damage Bonus Energy Damage, reduced by Partial Success as normal. This is a Futton technique and uses Futton Conversion's Wounding rule.
Unranked

After one of your Futton Jutsu that boiled off at least 1 gallon of water resolves, you may immediately use Steam Engine as an Interrupt. Gain Steam equal to one-fifth of the triggering Jutsu's final Chakra cost, rounded down, to a maximum of 3 Steam and your Steam Capacity.
You cannot use Steam Engine on a Jutsu that used Critical Pressure as part of the same declaration. Steam Engine does not itself trigger Pressure Engine.

Declare as a Link to an arm-based Basic Unarmed Attack or Unarmed/Combo Taijutsu. Add 5 Stamina, +2d8 base damage and +2 Speed. The linked attack gains Knockback 4, increased to 6 if Jet Booster is active on the attacking arm or back. The piston needs no separate Shape Change or body-region allocation and retracts after the attack; Partial Defense reduces Knockback normally.

Create one Small or Medium melee weapon arm using an unmodified equipment size/class profile. It is a chakra-reinforced natural limb, uses PDB and qualifies for that weapon class's Bukijutsu. Reshape — fixed Speed 2: change the weapon profile or transfer it to the other arm. Handseals require restoring the hand. The weapon has no separate Durability or WDP; attacks against it affect you. A two-handed profile still requires the other hand, and the limb cannot share a region with Carapace.

Using Shape Change, you create a jet-like appendage which emits bursts of chakra allowing you to dash around the battlefield and empower your attacks with more momentum. These may be created attached to one of your limbs or on your back. While you have a limb transformed into a Jet Booster you gain access to the following actions:
Burst (Delay +4, Link) - You reduce the speed of any Taijutsu attack by 2. You can also treat the attack as being +10 Speed for determining attack while moving.
Jump (Speed 2, Chakra 10, Link) - You instantly move in any direction (including up) with a burst of chakra up to your ninjutsu damage bonus in yards which cannot be reduced in any way. This may be added as a link to a dodge increasing its speed by 3.
Lotus Cannon (Speed 10, Delay 5, Chakra 15) - You fire a high density projectile of pure chakra. This deals damage equal to your basic attack and has a range of 40.

Fire three compressed chakra blasts from temporary jets. You can spend up to 3 SC; each adds one additional projectile, +2d10 damage, and +1 Accuracy. Treat the attack as a Multi-Throw for defenses but combine its damage for Wounding.
Grow a reinforced shell. Gain DR 20 and +3 Resistance against Knockback, Stun, and physical Immobilization. Spending 1 SC when hit increases the DR against that one attack to 35.

Requires a pinned living target and a free hand. Every use is a fresh Submission check and costs Stamina 24 / Control 5. Damage includes PDB × Final Speed plus d8s equal to Control remaining after payment. Immediately recover half the Vitality and HP actually removed, rounded down, capped at RES×2 Vitality and your normal maximum. Breaking contact ends the Submission and adds the normal 5 IC recovery.

Touch another willing living creature and spend 1–3 SC. Each charge costs ceil(RES/2) HP and restores RES×2 Vitality to the recipient. You must retain at least 1 HP and healing cannot exceed the recipient's maximum. Spending 3 SC may also suppress the penalties of one eligible Major or Severe physical Wound for 20 IC; it does not restore missing parts or affect Critical Wounds. Reapplication refreshes suppression rather than stacking.
Spend up to 3 SC. Recover RES x 2 Vitality per SC. If you spend 3 SC, you can instead remove one Minor Blunt, Piercing, or Slashing Wound.

Self-transformation with Special Upkeep 10. Gain 2 SC on activation once per combat; reaching 0 SC no longer ends the form. Your SC cap remains Current Willpower; passive generation continues and is faster while transformed. Natural Mutation has 4 ranks and a Speed 2 Shape Change may alter two regions. Weapon Surge: spend 1–3 SC for +2d8 base damage per SC on a Weapon Form attack. Sage Burst retains rank-based SC and halves attack Speed while respecting normal floors/Delay 4. Sage Jump spends J SC, Chakra 10+3J, Speed 2+J for J leaps up to NDB yards and can Link to Dodge. Lotus Volley spends L SC for one shot every 5 IC; each shot costs Chakra 10, uses current Ninjutsu Accuracy, Basic Unarmed dice and NDB×5.

Until the end of your next Action, reduce penalties to Stealth caused by moving by 5 and treat your body as ordinary environmental smoke for the purpose of mundane attempts to identify which part of a larger smoke cloud is you. Attacking, forming obvious handseals through Partial Reformation, or leaving all smoke or concealment ends this effect.

Create a voice or other sound you have personally heard, originating from any point in Range. The sound may speak words you choose, but it cannot convincingly reproduce information, accents, passwords, or verbal habits you have never heard from the source.
If you have successfully Read Memory containing the sound or voice, the reproduction is exact. A suspicious observer may contest your Genjutsu Accuracy with Awareness to identify it as false.

Project a short sensory scene from a memory you have personally experienced or successfully read. Choose up to 30 seconds of sight and sound. Creatures in the Area perceive the scene as an illusion layered over the real environment.
This technique does not control behaviour or conceal physical interaction with the real world. It is useful for showing witnesses exactly what someone remembers, reconstructing a crime scene, creating a distraction, or demonstrating a face, route, voice, or event without relying on description.

A discordant phrase catches in the target’s perception and repeatedly interrupts the transition between thought and action.
On a full hit, apply Stun 2. Until the end of the target’s next Action, the first Utility Action they declare has its final Speed increased by 3.
If cast through Sound-Hidden Tradition, targets must be able to hear you when the technique resolves.
On a full hit, choose one specific event, face, place, or piece of information the target personally experienced within the last month. For 1 hour they cannot consciously recall it.

Violence users increase Stun by 2 on a full hit. Melody users may instead exclude up to CHA/20 allies from the Area.
This is a Sound effect and is blocked by effects that explicitly prevent sound propagation.

Allies in the Area gain +2 Resistance against fear-based Immobilization effects and Stun, and +1 to Willpower rerolls.

Requires Creation mode. Create a mundane object up to a 2-yard cube or a wall with HP CHA×3 and DR NDB. It lasts 50 IC. This can create anything mundane. Requires Destruction mode. Base damage is 25d10, doubled to 50d10 against Barriers, Clones, Summons and created objects before Damage Bonus. Before the Attack, move up to half your normal Movement toward the target.

This Attack is a Bite and deals 75% Final Damage.

Lockjaw can trigger Predator’s Jaw normally.

Spend any amount of Hunger on activation. Gain +5 STR per Hunger spent, +5% Movement per Hunger spent, and natural Slashing unarmed attacks.
At the start of each turn while at 4+ Hunger, if a living hostile creature is within Melee Range you must either attack a hostile creature before taking a Utility Action or spend 1 Willpower to ignore this urge for 20 IC.

Draw and consecrate Jashin’s symbol beneath you. The circle lasts for the scene or until physically destroyed beyond recognition. You may have only one Consecrated Circle at a time.

Link this technique to an Insect Glaive Attack while your Kinsect is housed. Before making the Attack, move up to half your normal Vault distance. This movement may be vertical and follows the normal restrictions of Vault, but does not require a separate Vault Action or its Stamina cost.

For every full 3 yards you descend as part of this technique, gain +5% Wounding, to a maximum of +15%.
If you have Orange Extract, reduce any Wounding penalty caused by a successful Block against this Attack by 10%, minimum 0. This does not change the Block's normal damage reduction.
Heritage: Insect Glaive Corps; Triple Up

Consume Triple Up on declaration. The Kinsect launches first, the glaive follows, and hunter and companion spiral through the target before the wielder kicks away into open air.
Before the Attack, move up to your normal Vault distance in any direction. This movement may be vertical and ignores the usual requirement to begin Vault from a stable surface. The Attack gains +15% Wounding from the three consumed Extracts.
If the Attack hits, after damage resolves choose one Extract color the target can provide. Your Kinsect becomes Deployed carrying that Extract without requiring Dispatch Kinsect or another Defense. You may then move up to AGI/20 yards away from the target. If you finish unsupported, you begin Falling normally.
Threefold Ascension consumes Triple Up even if the Attack misses. Predator's Trinity does not retain an Extract when Triple Up is consumed this way.
Sanzengarasu no Jutsu - Scattering One Thousand Crows Technique
This summons a flock of chakra-created and -guided crows which surround and disorient them. The crows continuously multiply and clone themselves, and will soon surround the target entirely.

Choose one target within Range. Roll Ninjutsu Accuracy against its ordinary Defense on application; the initial Attack cannot be Dodged, but may be Parried or Blocked and deals no direct damage. On a full hit, the crows surround the victim and apply -1 Visibility, increasing that penalty by 1 every 10 IC to a maximum of -10. The crows disperse 10 IC after reaching -10, if Upkeep ends, or if the victim moves outside effective Range. These are real chakra-created crows, not Genjutsu; Genjutsu Defense and Kai do not apply.
An Area Attack that deals any damage to the affected target disperses these crows after the Attack resolves.
This technique allows the user to briefly levitate multiple kunai in mid-air using chakra, and then direct them at an opponent, more quickly than if each was being thrown individually.

This is added to a multi-throw action. The Chakra cost is equal to the multi-throw's Stamina cost and replaces it; the Damage is that of the multi-throw, though your ninjutsu, rather than physical, damage bonus is used. You use CHA/10, rather than DEX/10, to determine how many kunai you may throw.
Because this technique essentially throws the projectiles in a straight line, and lacks something in precision, it cannot be used with shuriken (of any form) or senbon; only kunai. The Speed is 4, plus half the Speed of the regular multithrow action.
Sen'un no Jutsu - Fog of War Technique

You trap a target in some manner of in-depth hallucination.
They may believe that you've run away and think they're giving pursuit, or be convinced that they're locked in combat with you. This technique is often a last-ditch resort to escape from a superior adversary, or bypass someone when there's no time to deal with them in direct combat.

The target rolls Genjutsu Defense against your Offense. On a full hit, it perceives a convincing false combat or escape and cannot take normal non-defensive Actions while affected. After Realizing, it may attempt Genjutsu Kai. If actual danger threatens it (an incoming Attack, a nearby explosive, or similar), the illusion ends immediately before that danger resolves, and the target may defend normally. The 30 IC Duration begins when this Jutsu takes effect.

A powerful, but potentially dangerous, technique, this allows the medic to transform a portion of their 'life energy' to another individual. Originally, this had no limitations; a medic could easily kill themselves to bring an ally back from the brink of death, which earned the technique its name. Over time, such extreme measures became less necessary (medics capable of using it were, after all, generally more valuable to the village than anyone they might be healing), and the version of the technique taught to medical nin was altered to prevent that.

Declare X when you use this Jutsu. After paying its Chakra cost, advance your Fatigue by X; X must be at least 1 and cannot render you unconscious. You cannot use this technique on yourself.
Each Fatigue level spent heals 20% of the recipient's HP and 10% of their Vitality, reduces their Fatigue level by 1, and resets their Chakra and Stamina penalties to 0.
Each Fatigue level also lets the recipient ignore one existing Wound of their choice for X in-character days. They must ignore all Minor Wounds before Major and all Major before Severe. This technique cannot ignore Critical Wounds.
Fatigue: X voluntary levels (X must be at least 1)

A thin spear of brilliant lightning clings to its victim and immediately searches for another path.

A low ceiling of charged chakra gathers over the battlefield and static crawls across every surface beneath it.

Every charged creature and object becomes part of one enormous circuit as lightning starts travelling everywhere at once.

A perfectly smooth wall of translucent glass erupts from the earth, spreading fractures through the battlefield whenever it is struck.

Create a Glass wall up to 12 yards long, 6 yards high and 1 yard wide. It has HP equal to (NDB + 20) × 8 and 15 DR. The wall remains while its Upkeep is maintained. A tiny needle of colourless chakra slips through the target and leaves a dead sensation spreading through their chakra network.

The user floods an Area with chakra designed to destroy coherence in other chakra, making barriers flicker and constructs fracture.

Kage Shuriken no Jutsu - Shadow Shuriken Technique

Throw two weapons of the same type but resolve them as one attack.
After seeing the target's first Defense result, you can force them to reroll that Defense against the second trajectory. If you do, the attack deals 75% Final Damage and cannot inflict a Wound above Major.
Kugutsu Kuchiyose no Jutsu — Puppet Summoning Technique

Store or release up to X Puppets from Puppet Scrolls you carry. Each Puppet requires one Scroll. Released Puppets appear in legal spaces within 3 yards of you.
When used as a Link to Kugutsu no Jutsu, add Chakra +5 + X, Speed +X and Seal Speed +4 instead of using this technique’s standalone Speed. The released Puppets may immediately be selected as Active Puppets for Kugutsu no Jutsu.
Karashi may learn and use this technique without Seal Training or other general Sealing-Ninjutsu access. It still counts as Sealing Ninjutsu for effects that interact with that tag.

Transform the Primary to appear as the User.
Immediately resolve the normal Hide Among Clones action using the transformed Primary as one Clone, without paying Hide Among Clones’ additional Speed. Make the normal Stealth contest, and thereafter use the normal Observe and random-target rules for being hidden among Clones.
The transformation ends if the Puppet becomes Disabled or Inactive, ceases to be Primary, Kugutsu no Jutsu ends, or it visibly uses equipment or mechanisms that make the disguise impossible.

When the User is targeted by a single-target Attack, swap positions with the Primary. Both positions must be legal and the Primary must be within Frame Range before the swap.

The Primary becomes the target of the triggering Attack and may declare one legal Defensive Interrupt. Pay both Interrupts’ costs. For that Attack, advance the User’s IC once using the higher Final Speed of Puppet Substitution or the Puppet’s Defensive Interrupt.
If the Primary cannot legally occupy the User’s former position, the technique fails and its costs are still paid.

Link to a Ballistic Attack. After it resolves, move up to AGI/20 yards directly away from the target (maximum 5). Heavy halves this movement unless Braced when the Attack was declared. Cannot pass through creatures or solid barriers.
Exchange currently loaded ammunition for a compatible Load. If empty at the start, new Load enters with half Magazine, rounded up; otherwise preserve remaining rounds. Counts as Reload.
Make a Ballistic Attack; +50% damage to Armor Durability, physical Barriers, objects and destructible monster parts. With Pierce ammunition, +5% Wounding.

Make a hurried Ballistic Attack. It cannot benefit from Aim, Predator's Zero or an effect that requires you to be Braced.

Choose visible creature within Range; next Ballistic Attack against it gains +10% Wounding. Ends on voluntary movement, Reload, weapon change, targeting another creature, target leaving Range or after one Attack. If Scoped, may Aim as part of this action.
Reload completely; choose two compatible ammunition types for which you possess Loads. Choose type each shot until magazine is empty or removed. Deduct rounds from each Load used.

Requires Heavy Bowgun Frame and Braced. Consume all loaded ammunition. +10% Wounding, or +15% if target has Major Wound, destroyed Armor or destroyed monster part. Wyvern Shell applies its normal Speed, Stamina and Wounding modifiers but does not add its +6 Damage Dice again.
